source: client application note — VIN code identification (Tesla example)

title.en: VIN Code Identification: A Tesla Example
title.zh: 汽车 VIN 码识别 —— 以特斯拉为例

subtitle.en: Multiple VIN points across the vehicle — laser marking and high-performance labels, chosen by application.
subtitle.zh: 全车多点 VIN 标识 —— 按场景选择激光刻印与高性能标签。

seo_desc.en: How modern vehicles like Tesla identify the VIN across windshield, door jamb, structural body and battery packs — combining permanent laser marking with durable industrial labels for lifecycle traceability and anti-counterfeiting.
seo_desc.zh: 现代汽车（如特斯拉）如何在挡风玻璃、门框、车身结构件与电池包上标识 VIN——结合永久激光刻印与耐久工业标签，实现全生命周期追溯与防伪。

overview.en: Application: Vehicle Identification (VIN) in automotive manufacturing. Typical points include the windshield VIN, the door-jamb certification label, the structural (hidden) VIN and battery-pack labels.
overview.zh: 应用：整车制造中的车辆识别码（VIN）标识。典型部位包括挡风玻璃 VIN、门框认证标签、车身结构件（隐藏）VIN 与电池包标签。

challenges.en: A VIN must stay readable and traceable for the vehicle's whole service life. Different locations face different environments, so no single method fits everywhere — manufacturers must balance durability, compliance, serviceability and tamper resistance.
challenges.zh: VIN 需在整车寿命内保持清晰可读、可追溯。不同部位环境各异，单一标识方式难以通用——需在耐久性、合规、可维护与防篡改之间取得平衡。

solution_intro.en: Tesla identifies the VIN at several points, each with the technology that fits: a laser-marked VIN under the windshield for quick inspection, a door-jamb certification label for regulatory data, hidden VIN engraving on structural body parts to resist tampering, and durable labels on battery packs and drive units for warranty and lifecycle traceability.
solution_intro.zh: 特斯拉在全车多点标识 VIN，按场景选择技术：挡风玻璃下方激光 VIN 便于快速目视；门框认证标签承载法规信息；车身结构件上隐藏 VIN 刻印防篡改；电池包与驱动单元用耐久标签，支持质保与全生命周期追溯。

en.label: Windshield laser VIN
en.text: Laser-marked VIN beneath the windshield for quick visual inspection.

en.label: Door-jamb certification label
en.text: Carries the required regulatory and compliance information.

en.label: Structural hidden VIN
en.text: Permanently engraved on body structure to prevent tampering.

en.label: Battery-pack labels
en.text: Durable labels on packs and drive units for warranty and lifecycle traceability.

zh.label: 挡风玻璃激光 VIN
zh.text: 挡风玻璃下方激光刻印 VIN，便于快速目视检查。

zh.label: 门框认证标签
zh.text: 承载所需的法规与合规信息。

zh.label: 结构件隐藏 VIN
zh.text: 车身结构件上永久刻印，有效防止篡改。

zh.label: 电池包标签
zh.text: 电池包与驱动单元采用耐久标签，支持质保与全生命周期追溯。

value.en: Combining permanent laser marking with high-performance labels improves traceability, supports compliance, simplifies maintenance and strengthens anti-counterfeiting across the vehicle lifecycle.
value.zh: 将永久激光刻印与高性能标签结合，可提升可追溯性、支撑合规、简化维护，并在整车生命周期内增强防伪。
